title: Remote work setup
content:
Think I've perfected the WFH/remote setup.

Inspired by a post from [Vitalik](https://vitalik.eth.limo/general/2022/06/20/backpack.html); 

Try to find some good working spots and stick to it, coworking are better than cafés.

### From Vitalik Post:

General guidelines:

- USBC Maximalist
- Uniqlo Maximalist
- Layer for Warmth
- eSIM > Local SIM
- Bag-Inside-A-Bag Structure 
- Have some fun non optimized things

### My stack:

Tech:
- eSIMs (airalo)
- Electric adapter
- Laptop
- Phone
- Charger base with cable (for laptop + phone)
- Garmin watch + charging cable
- second screen with usb-c cable
- kindle 
- earbuds wireless
- wired earphones

### Non tech
- 40L backpack (Lowe Alpine XXX)
- totebags (bag inside a bag)
- Passport/credit card/driving license/visa
- Bamboo bowl


Misc/Medical:
- Melatonin+ sleeping pills
- toothbrush + toothpaste
- deodorant roll
- nailclippers/tweezers
- 1L Water bottle
- sleeping mask
- Moisturizer

Clothing:
- x8 T-shirts
- x8 Underwear
- x8 Socks
- x1 Thermal Tights
- x1 Sweater
- x1 Packable Jacket
- x1 Pant
- x1 Sweatpant
- x1 Gloves
- x1 Heavy Shoe
- x1 Flip Flop
- (1x short)

- 1x running shoes
- 1x running shorts
- 1x running shirt

To be refined:
- 20000 mah Laptop Friendly Powerbank
